verses.pali: “Aṭṭhānametaṁ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṁ kāyaduccaritassa iṭṭho kanto manāpo vipāko nibbatteyya. Netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: “It is impossible, mendicants, it cannot happen for a likable, desirable, agreeable result to come from bad bodily conduct.

verses.pali: Ṭhānañca kho etaṁ, bhikkhave, vijjati yaṁ kāyaduccaritassa aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo vipāko nibbatteyya. Ṭhānametaṁ vijjatī”ti.
verses.english: But it is possible for an unlikable, undesirable, disagreeable result to come from bad bodily conduct.”
